bundlingNotes: General Rule F: 'The rates set forth herein do not include any charge made for title search, title examination, closing, or escrow services performed by the Insurer, or any of its approved attorneys or agents. Charges made for such services are in addition to the rates and charges set forth herein.' [Note: same manual's Applicability clause elsewhere states rates apply to 'land located in Missouri' with MO county codes and MO-specific form numbers -- this is the correct-state FNTI filing, unlike the MI manual's Alabama text artifact.] The Closing Protection Letter fee ($25/side, statutorily mandated) is the only true settlement-adjacent dollar figure in the manual.

bundlingNotes: Section 1 Introduction: 'The rates shown do not include charges for title search, surveys, escrow, closing services, settlement services, recording fees, other charges, or other monies advanced on behalf of an applicant.' Explicit and unambiguous exclusion. The $25.00 Closing Protection Letter fee exactly matches FNTI's $25/side CPL fee (both citing the same RSMo 381.022 statutory basis) -- a clean cross-underwriter corroboration on the one line item both manuals actually price.
